## DISCORD Registry

**Endpoint:** GET /webhook/discord-registry

**Description:** Liste tous les workflows Discord disponibles avec leurs metadonnees.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "version": "1.0",
  "updated_at": "2025-01-05T...",
  "n8n": {
    "host": "host2.local",
    "port": 5678,
    "webhook_base": "http://host2.local:5678/webhook"
  },
  "total_tools": 5,
  "tools": { ... }
}
```
